title: FTK Studio

services.name: Yoga Instructor
services.desc: This slow, mindful yoga class is designed to support physical ease and cognitive clarity-ideal for older adults or anyone seeking a gentler approach to movement. We focus on caring for the joints, improving muscular stability, and maintaining balance, while also nurturing mental focus and emotional well-being.

blurb: FTK Studio is a community based fitness studio offering movement classes for all ages. Our minority women-owned studio in Bernal Heights is a place where people can come together to move, learn, and grow. We believe in the power of movement to enhance both physical and mental well-being. Our team is dedicated to providing a welcoming and inclusive environment for everyone who walks through our doors.
